reported_status: ROOT derives the local three-height pose map and a restricted one-selector restoration limit, then separates physical shape bounds from observation-only acceptance. Small errors can remain while observed function passes; no universal one-input impossibility or refutation of the P2 rehearsal is claimed. Complete geometry-writing advantage remains open.
scientific_scope_status: ROOT derives the local three-height pose map and a restricted one-selector restoration limit, then separates physical shape bounds from observation-only acceptance. Small errors can remain while observed function passes; no universal one-input impossibility or refutation of the P2 rehearsal is claimed. Complete geometry-writing advantage remains open. The introduced ball-centered three-prop geometry has invertible nine-state height Jacobians. A single selector supplies one local tangent, with zero tangent on a truly flat land. Acceptance requires either a valid independent physical bound or observations with their complete uncertainty.
